entities.name: Tuberculosis
entities.description: Chronic granulomatous infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex, transmitted airborne via droplet nuclei, primarily affecting pulmonary parenchyma with characteristic cavitation, but capable of extrapulmonary dissemination.

entities.name: Chronic productive cough
entities.description: Persistent cough lasting >2-3 weeks progressing from dry irritation to copious mucoid or purulent sputum.

entities.name: Hemoptysis
entities.description: Expectoration of blood ranging from streaked sputum to massive hemorrhage due to cavitary vascular erosion.

entities.name: Apical cavitary disease
entities.description: Cavitation within apical and posterior upper lobe pulmonary segments caused by caseous parenchymal necrosis.

entities.name: Endobronchial tuberculosis
entities.description: Granulomatous inflammation and ulceration of the tracheobronchial tree causing localized wheezing and atelectasis.

entities.name: Tuberculous pleurisy
entities.description: Pleuritic inflammation manifesting as acute or subacute unilateral chest pain with an exudative pleural effusion.

entities.name: Tuberculous empyema
entities.description: Chronic purulent pleural space infection with heavy calcified pleural peel from direct cavitary rupture.

entities.name: Tuberculous spondylitis
entities.description: Pott disease characterized by chronic back pain, anterior vertebral body collapse, and disc space destruction.

entities.name: Psoas cold abscess
entities.description: Slowly expanding retroperitoneal purulent collection tracking along the psoas fascia without inflammatory heat.

entities.name: Gibbus deformity
entities.description: Sharp angular kyphosis of the spine produced by structural collapse of one or more anterior vertebral bodies.

entities.name: Tuberculous peripheral arthritis
entities.description: Chronic indolent monoarthritis characteristically targeting large weight-bearing joints such as hip or knee.

entities.name: Tuberculous dactylitis
entities.description: Spina ventosa manifesting as painless cortical ballooning and soft-tissue swelling of short tubular bones.

entities.name: Tuberculous lymphadenitis
entities.description: Scrofula characterized by painless, firm, matted cervical lymph node chains that progress into cold abscesses.

entities.name: Scrofuloderma
entities.description: Direct cutaneous breakdown and chronic sinus formation overlying caseating lymph nodes or skeletal tuberculosis.

entities.name: Tuberculous meningitis
entities.description: Subacute basilar meningoencephalitis with persistent headache, fever, vomiting, and cognitive alteration.

entities.name: Cranial nerve palsies
entities.description: Neurological deficits of cranial nerves III, VI, and VII caused by dense gelatinous basilar exudative entrapment.

entities.name: Intracranial tuberculoma
entities.description: Caseating space-occupying granulomatous brain masses presenting with focal deficits and intracranial hypertension.

entities.name: Tuberculous encephalopathy
entities.description: Diffuse pediatric cerebral syndrome marked by stupor and seizures without severe meningeal signs.

entities.name: Tuberculous peritonitis
entities.description: Granulomatous peritoneal seeding producing subacute ascites, abdominal distension, and doughy peritonitis.

entities.name: Ileocecal tuberculosis
entities.description: Hypertrophic granulomatous inflammation of the terminal ileum and cecum forming a palpable right lower quadrant mass.

entities.name: Tuberculous enteritis
entities.description: Transverse ulcerations of the small intestine resulting in malabsorption, diarrhea, and cicatricial strictures.

entities.name: Tuberculous pericarditis
entities.description: Granulomatous pericardial effusion presenting with dyspnea, elevated venous pressure, and high constrictive risk.

entities.name: Constrictive pericarditis
entities.description: Fibrocalcific pericardial encasement causing systemic venous congestion and impaired diastolic cardiac filling.

entities.name: Renal tuberculosis
entities.description: Chronic parenchymal caseation and calyceal ulceration presenting with sterile pyuria, hematuria, and dysuria.

entities.name: Ureteral strictures
entities.description: Fibrotic narrowing of the distal ureter producing hydronephrosis and nonfunctioning tuberculous autonephrectomy.

entities.name: Tuberculous epididymo-orchitis
entities.description: Craggy, painless induration of the epididymis with beaded vas deferens and chronic draining scrotal fistulae.

entities.name: Tuberculous salpingitis
entities.description: Chronic granulomatous involvement of the fallopian tubes causing pelvic inflammatory masses and infertility.

entities.name: Adrenal tuberculosis
entities.description: Bilateral caseous destruction of adrenal cortices manifesting as primary adrenal insufficiency and hypotension.

entities.name: Miliary tuberculosis
entities.description: Disseminated hematogenous tuberculosis marked by tiny millet-seed granulomas distributed across multiple organs.

entities.name: Miliary choroidal tubercles
entities.description: Pale yellow elevated granulomatous choroidal lesions visible on retinal examination during miliary spread.

entities.name: Laryngeal tuberculosis
entities.description: Ulcerative infection of vocal cords and larynx presenting with hoarseness, odynophagia, and intense infectivity.

entities.name: Lupus vulgaris
entities.description: Chronic progressive post-primary cutaneous tuberculosis producing destructive apple-jelly plaques.

entities.name: Erythema induratum
entities.description: Bazin disease characterized by chronic recurrent tender violaceous subcutaneous nodules on lower calves.

entities.name: Tuberculous otitis media
entities.description: Painless chronic otorrhea with multiple tympanic perforations and pale exuberant granulations.

entities.name: Tuberculous mastoiditis
entities.description: Granulomatous temporal bone destruction with painless postauricular swelling and facial nerve weakness.

entities.name: Hepatosplenic tuberculosis
entities.description: Micronodular granulomatous infiltration of liver and spleen manifesting as hepatosplenomegaly and cachexia.

entities.name: Tuberculous osteomyelitis
entities.description: Extraspinal osseous tuberculosis targeting metaphyses and epiphyses with cystic osteolysis and cold abscess.

entities.name: Tuberculous tenosynovitis
entities.description: Chronic synovial sheath thickening along wrist or ankle tendons containing fibrinous melon-seed rice bodies.

entities.name: Primary pulmonary tuberculosis
entities.description: Initial alveolar focus accompanied by regional lymphangitis and ipsilateral hilar lymphadenopathy.

entities.name: Post-primary reactivation tuberculosis
entities.description: Recrudescence of apical latent tuberculous foci following immune breakdown, causing extensive cavitary destruction.

entities.name: Rasmussen aneurysm
entities.description: Inflammatory pseudoaneurysm of a pulmonary arterial branch traversing a tuberculous cavitary wall.

entities.name: Drenching night sweats
entities.description: Soaking nocturnal diaphoresis requiring change of clothing, reflecting episodic inflammatory cytokine release.

entities.name: Cachectic wasting
entities.description: Severe involuntary loss of adipose tissue and lean muscle mass resulting from chronic systemic consumption.

entities.name: Post-tussive apical rales
entities.description: Fine inspiratory crackles heard over the upper lobes after coughing, reflecting cavitary alveolar exudate.

entities.name: Amphoric breath sounds
entities.description: Hollow low-pitched cavernous respiratory sounds heard over large open apical cavities communicating with a bronchus.

entities.name: Matted cold lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Nontender coalescent cervical lymph nodes lacking warmth or erythema that break down into fluctuant collections.

entities.name: Chronic scrofuloderma fistulae
entities.description: Indolent cutaneous draining sinus tracts with undermined violaceous edges arising from ruptured caseous nodes.

entities.name: Sharp angular kyphosis
entities.description: Prominent localized dorsal spinal angle resulting from anterior collapse of vertebral bodies in Pott disease.

entities.name: Psoas sign
entities.description: Pain provoked by passive hyperextension of the hip due to stretching of an inflamed retroperitoneal psoas sheath.

entities.name: Palpable right flank mass
entities.description: Nontender deep fullness in the lumbar or flank region representing gravitating cold abscess fluid from spondylitis.

entities.name: Doughy abdomen
entities.description: Characteristic boggy, plastic abdominal wall resistance on palpation resulting from fibroadhesive tuberculous peritonitis.

entities.name: Erythema nodosum
entities.description: Tender erythematous pretibial subcutaneous nodules arising as a delayed-type hypersensitivity reaction to mycobacteria.

entities.name: Phlyctenular keratoconjunctivitis
entities.description: Small nodular limbic and corneal ulcerations reflecting cell-mediated allergic hypersensitivity to tuberculoprotein.

entities.name: Nuchal rigidity
entities.description: Marked involuntary resistance to passive neck flexion reflecting chronic basilar meningeal inflammation.

entities.name: Kernig sign
entities.description: Pain and hamstring resistance during knee extension with the hip flexed to 90 degrees due to meningeal irritation.

entities.name: Brudzinski sign
entities.description: Involuntary flexion of knees and hips upon passive forward flexion of the neck caused by meningeal inflammation.

entities.name: Oculomotor nerve palsy
entities.description: Ptosis, pupillary dilation, and divergent strabismus due to entrapment of cranial nerve III in basilar tuberculous exudate.

entities.name: Abducens nerve palsy
entities.description: Inability to abduct the eye causing horizontal diplopia from basal subarachnoid compression of cranial nerve VI.

entities.name: Fundoscopic choroid tubercles
entities.description: Pale yellow, rounded elevated granulomatous nodules visible on the choroid retina during miliary dissemination.

entities.name: Apple-jelly nodules
entities.description: Translucent brownish-yellow granulomas seen upon diascopy glass slide pressure on lupus vulgaris plaques.

entities.name: Evening fever spikes
entities.description: Diurnal low-grade pyrexia typically peaking in late afternoon or evening accompanied by nocturnal defervescence.

entities.name: Dullness to percussion
entities.description: Stony dull percussion note over lower lung fields indicating accumulation of tuberculous exudative pleural fluid.

entities.name: Pericardial friction rub
entities.description: Superficial scratchy high-pitched precordial murmur heard during early fibrin deposition in tuberculous pericarditis.

entities.name: Pulsus paradoxus
entities.description: Inspiratory systolic blood pressure decrease >10 mmHg signaling cardiac tamponade from tense pericardial effusion.

entities.name: Kussmaul sign
entities.description: Paradoxical rise in jugular venous pressure during inspiration reflecting tuberculous constrictive pericarditis.

entities.name: Whispering pectoriloquy
entities.description: Pronounced acoustic transmission of whispered syllables auscultated through consolidated lung tissue or cavitary borders.

entities.name: Right iliac mass
entities.description: Firm, fixed nontender mass palpated in the right lower abdominal quadrant due to hypertrophic ileocecal tuberculosis.

entities.name: Craggy epididymal induration
entities.description: Painless hard irregular nodular thickening of the epididymis with beaded enlargement of the vas deferens.

entities.name: Apical cavitary infiltrates
entities.description: Thick-walled cavitary lesions and heterogeneous consolidations in apical and posterior upper lobe segments.

entities.name: Tree-in-bud nodular opacities
entities.description: Branching linear opacities with 2-4 mm centrilobular nodules on high-resolution chest CT indicating active endobronchial spread.

entities.name: Bilateral miliary micronodules
entities.description: Diffuse uniform 1-2 mm micronodular interstitial opacities evenly scattered from lung apices to bases.

entities.name: Ghon complex
entities.description: Calcified subpleural parenchymal nodule paired with ipsilateral calcified hilar lymphadenopathy on chest imaging.

entities.name: Intervertebral disc space narrowing
entities.description: Narrowing of disc height with erosion of contiguous vertebral endplates on spinal MRI or CT.

entities.name: Vertebral endplate erosion
entities.description: Destructive lytic scalloping of anterior cortical margins of contiguous vertebral bodies on spinal CT or MRI.

entities.name: Psoas fluid collection
entities.description: Rim-enhancing hypodense fluid collection within the psoas muscle on contrast-enhanced CT or ultrasound.

entities.name: Basilar meningeal enhancement
entities.description: Thick gelatinous enhancement of the basilar cisterns and circle of Willis on contrast-enhanced brain MRI.

entities.name: Communicating hydrocephalus
entities.description: Dilatation of cerebral ventricles resulting from CSF absorption blockade by thick basilar tuberculous exudate.

entities.name: Ring-enhancing cerebral tuberculoma
entities.description: Intracranial mass with nodular ring enhancement, central low T2 signal, and surrounding vasogenic edema.

entities.name: Pericardial effusion
entities.description: Anechoic fluid layer separating parietal and visceral pericardium with fibrinous stranding on echocardiography.

entities.name: Splenic microabscesses
entities.description: Multiple small hypoechoic lesions throughout splenic parenchyma identified on bedside FASH ultrasound.

entities.name: Abdominal lymphadenopathy
entities.description: Mesenteric and retroperitoneal lymph nodes enlarged >1.5 cm with central hypoechoic necrosis on ultrasound.

entities.name: Ascitic peritoneal fluid
entities.description: Free fluid with fibrinous septations and thickened peritoneal reflections on abdominal ultrasound.

entities.name: Pulmonary wedge collapse
entities.description: Segmental or lobar atelectasis produced by bronchial obstruction from endobronchial TB or enlarged nodes.

entities.name: Pleural loculation
entities.description: Septated pleural effusion with thickened visceral and parietal pleural surfaces on bedside thoracic ultrasound.

entities.name: Rasmussen aneurysm dilation
entities.description: Contrast-opacified saccular pseudoaneurysm of a pulmonary artery branch within a cavitary wall on CT angiography.

entities.name: Ileocecal bowel thickening
entities.description: Concentric mural thickening of terminal ileum and cecal amputation or deformity on abdominal CT scan.

entities.name: Hydronephrosis and infundibular stenosis
entities.description: Focal calyceal hydrocalyx with infundibular narrowing and ragged ureteral strictures on urography.

entities.name: Acid-fast bacilli
entities.description: Bright red rod-shaped acid-fast organisms visualized on Ziehl-Neelsen or Kinyoun stained microscopic smears.

entities.name: Auramine-O fluorescence
entities.description: Vivid glowing green-yellow rod-shaped bacilli detected under fluorescence microscopy of sputum.

entities.name: GeneXpert MTB/RIF positive
entities.description: Automated cartridge-based nucleic acid amplification directly identifying M. tuberculosis DNA within 2 hours.

entities.name: rpoB mutation detection
entities.description: Rapid molecular identification of missense mutations conferring rifampicin resistance in the rpoB core region.

entities.name: Elevated adenosine deaminase
entities.description: Elevated ADA (>35-40 U/L) in pleural, pericardial, or peritoneal effusions reflecting local T-cell activation.

entities.name: Exudative lymphocytic effusion
entities.description: Serous fluid demonstrating high protein (>30 g/L), high LDH, and overwhelming lymphocyte predominance (>80%).

entities.name: Markedly elevated ESR
entities.description: Severe acceleration of erythrocyte sedimentation rate (>60-100 mm/h) signaling active granulomatous disease.

entities.name: Elevated C-reactive protein
entities.description: Moderate to marked elevation of serum C-reactive protein accompanying ongoing mycobacterial replication.

entities.name: Normocytic normochromic anemia
entities.description: Anemia of chronic disease with hemoglobin 8-11 g/dL, blunted iron utilization, and elevated serum ferritin.

entities.name: Normal leukocyte count
entities.description: Peripheral white blood cell count remains within normal limits (4,000-11,000/mcL) in uncomplicated tuberculosis.

entities.name: Elevated monocyte-lymphocyte ratio
entities.description: Relative monocytosis with absolute or relative lymphopenia producing an elevated ML ratio on differential count.

entities.name: Reactive thrombocytosis
entities.description: Elevated peripheral platelet count (400,000-600,000/mcL) driven by interleukin-6 in chronic inflammation.

entities.name: Sterile pyuria
entities.description: Presence of white blood cells in urine sediment without growth on routine bacterial culture media.

entities.name: CSF lymphocytic pleocytosis
entities.description: CSF leukocyte count of 100-500/mcL with predominant lymphocytes (>70-80%) and elevated protein (>100 mg/dL).

entities.name: Markedly depressed CSF glucose
entities.description: CSF-to-serum glucose ratio severely decreased (<0.30) due to mycobacterial glycolysis and transport block.

entities.name: Hypercalcemia
entities.description: Elevated serum calcium (10.5-13 mg/dL) caused by 1-alpha-hydroxylase synthesis by activated granuloma histiocytes.

entities.name: Hyponatremia
entities.description: Low serum sodium (<135 mEq/L) resulting from SIADH or tuberculous destruction of the adrenal cortex.

entities.name: Urine lipoarabinomannan positive
entities.description: Point-of-care lateral flow detection of mycobacterial lipoarabinomannan in urine of immunocompromised patients.

entities.name: Positive IGRA assay
entities.description: Interferon-gamma release by sensitized memory T cells after incubation with ESAT-6 and CFP-10 peptides.

entities.name: Airborne droplet nuclei
entities.description: Inhalation of microscopic aerosolized droplet nuclei (1-5 um) expelled by coughing or sneezing active cases.

entities.name: Household smear-positive contacts
entities.description: Close prolonged domestic cohabitation with individuals having active AFB smear-positive pulmonary disease.

entities.name: Crowded congregate settings
entities.description: Poorly ventilated enclosed spaces such as prisons, homeless shelters, refugee camps, and barracks.

entities.name: Healthcare occupational exposure
entities.description: Occupational risk among clinical and laboratory staff during sputum induction, bronchoscopy, or autopsy.

entities.name: High-burden endemic regions
entities.description: Prolonged travel or residence in hyperendemic countries of South-East Asia, sub-Saharan Africa, and Western Pacific.

entities.name: Unpasteurized dairy ingestion
entities.description: Ingestion of raw unpasteurized milk from infected cattle carrying Mycobacterium bovis producing intestinal TB.

entities.name: Advanced HIV infection
entities.description: Severe CD4 T-cell lymphopenia increasing tuberculosis reactivation risk by greater than 12-fold to 20-fold.

entities.name: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
entities.description: Chronic hyperglycemia causing impaired alveolar macrophage chemotaxis and tripling reactivation risk.

entities.name: Occupational silicosis
entities.description: Inhalation of crystalline silica particles causing toxic alveolar macrophage lysis and conferring up to a 30-fold risk.

entities.name: Anti-TNF biologic therapy
entities.description: Monoclonal anti-TNF agents (infliximab, adalimumab) dissolving granulomas and triggering rapid reactivation.

entities.name: Systemic corticosteroid therapy
entities.description: Prolonged prednisone therapy (>15 mg/day) depressing cell-mediated immunity and macrophage bactericidal function.

entities.name: Solid organ transplantation
entities.description: Pharmacological calcineurin and purine inhibitor immunosuppression in renal, hepatic, or cardiac transplant hosts.

entities.name: End-stage renal disease
entities.description: Uremia-induced immune depression and hemodialysis impairing cell-mediated containment of mycobacteria.

entities.name: Severe undernutrition
entities.description: Protein-calorie malnutrition impairing T-cell mediated cytokine synthesis and macrophage function.

entities.name: Chronic tobacco smoking
entities.description: Impairment of bronchial mucociliary clearance and macrophage phagocytosis doubling lifetime tuberculosis risk.

entities.name: Chronic alcohol misuse
entities.description: Alcohol-mediated blunting of alveolar macrophage responses and microbicidal nitric oxide generation.

entities.name: Infancy and young childhood
entities.description: Immature cellular immunity in children under five years predisposing to rapid dissemination and meningitis.

entities.name: Old age
entities.description: Age-related immunosenescence causing loss of granuloma containment of latent mycobacteria acquired decades earlier.

entities.name: Indolent incubation period
entities.description: Subacute clinical symptom onset developing slowly across 2 to 12 weeks after primary exposure.

entities.name: Early post-primary progression
entities.description: Development of active progressive disease in approximately 5% of exposed immunocompetent hosts within 1 to 2 years.

entities.name: Lifelong latent persistence
entities.description: Asymptomatic dormancy of viable bacilli within calcified granulomas persisting over decades or lifetimes.

entities.name: Late recrudescence latency
entities.description: Reactivation of remote dormant mycobacteria occurring decades after exposure when host cellular immunity wanes.

entities.name: Hyperacute onset of shock
entities.description: Cardiovascular collapse and septic shock developing in <24-48 hours rules out uncomplicated tuberculosis.

entities.name: Hyperacute respiratory failure
entities.description: Severe hypoxemic respiratory distress evolving within <48 hours strongly excludes uncomplicated indolent TB.

entities.name: Massive neutrophilic leukocytosis
entities.description: Peripheral white blood cell count >25,000/mcL with severe left shift excludes uncomplicated tuberculosis.

entities.name: Severe peripheral eosinophilia
entities.description: Absolute peripheral eosinophils >1,500/mcL or >15% rules out tuberculosis and points to parasitic lung flukes.

entities.name: Rapid beta-lactam clearance
entities.description: Complete clinical and radiographic resolution within 5-7 days of beta-lactam therapy excludes mycobacteria.

entities.name: High serum procalcitonin
entities.description: Serum procalcitonin markedly elevated >5-10 ng/mL strongly favors acute pyogenic bacteremia over indolent TB.

entities.name: Hyperacute disc destruction
entities.description: Destruction of intervertebral discs and endplates developing within 48-72 hours indicates pyogenic bacterial infection.

entities.name: Warm erythematous lymphadenitis
entities.description: Exquisitely tender, hot, rapidly enlarging cervical lymphadenopathy rules out cold tuberculous scrofula.

entities.name: Exclusively neutrophilic pleural fluid
entities.description: Pleural fluid with >90% polymorphonuclear leukocytes indicates acute pyogenic parapneumonic empyema.

entities.name: Exclusively transudative pleural effusion
entities.description: Low pleural protein (<30 g/L) and low LDH rules out tuberculous pleuritis, indicating heart failure or cirrhosis.

entities.name: Rapidly migratory arthralgias
entities.description: Fleeting polyarticular arthritis shifting between joints within hours to days rules out tuberculous monoarthritis.

entities.name: Centrilobular tree-sparing emphysema
entities.description: Thin-walled bullae without surrounding infiltrate or tree-in-bud opacities excludes active cavitary tuberculosis.

entities.name: Eccentric mass without cavitation
entities.description: Spiculated pulmonary nodule without fever, cavity, or tree-in-bud satellite opacities points to bronchogenic carcinoma.

entities.name: Gram-negative bacillary blood culture
entities.description: Rapid bacteremic isolation of Gram-negative rods within 24-48 hours establishes an alternative acute etiology.

entities.name: Fungal broad-based budding
entities.description: Thick-walled broad-based budding yeast cells seen on microscopy rules out mycobacteria and confirms blastomycosis.

entities.name: Pilot-wheel budding yeast
entities.description: Multiple daughter buds circumferentially surrounding a parent yeast cell confirms paracoccidioidomycosis.

entities.name: Non-caseating well-formed granulomas
entities.description: Biopsy revealing tightly packed non-necrotizing epithelioid granulomas without caseation confirms sarcoidosis.

entities.name: Hyperacute CSF neutrophilia
entities.description: CSF containing >1,000 leukocytes/mcL with >80% neutrophils and visible bacteria confirms acute purulent meningitis.

entities.name: Negative GeneXpert with culture
entities.description: Repeatedly negative rapid cartridge NAATs and negative 8-week automated liquid mycobacterial cultures exclude TB.

entities.name: Absence of tuberculin anergy
entities.description: Normal immune responsiveness with repeatedly non-reactive IGRA and TST assays makes tuberculosis highly improbable.

entities.name: Marked eosinophilic pleural effusion
entities.description: Pleural fluid eosinophilia >10% virtually excludes tuberculous pleurisy, favoring air/blood trauma or parasite.

entities.name: Rapid defervescence with macrolides
entities.description: Prompt clinical recovery within 72 hours of macrolide monotherapy rules out intrinsically resistant M. tuberculosis.

entities.name: Melioidosis
entities.description: Severe tropical Burkholderia pseudomallei infection causing cavitary pneumonia and visceral honeycomb microabscesses.

entities.name: Paragonimiasis
entities.description: Endemic freshwater crab lung fluke infection presenting with cavitary lung disease and marked eosinophilia.

entities.name: Paracoccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Endemic South American mycosis causing chronic pulmonary consolidation, mulberry stomatitis, and mariner wheel yeasts.

entities.name: Histoplasmosis
entities.description: Dimorphic fungal infection associated with bird and bat guano caves presenting with chronic cavitary lung disease.

entities.name: Blastomycosis
entities.description: Thermal dimorphic fungal infection causing verrucous skin ulcerations, lytic bone lesions, and cavitary pneumonia.

entities.name: Coccidioidomycosis
entities.description: Desert soil fungal infection (Valley Fever) presenting with cavitary pulmonary disease and endospore spherules.

entities.name: Pyogenic spondylodiscitis
entities.description: Acute bacterial infection of intervertebral discs and vertebrae typically caused by Staphylococcus aureus.

entities.name: Pyogenic psoas abscess
entities.description: Acute bacterial suppurative collection in the iliopsoas muscle causing high fever, local warmth, and toxic leukocytosis.

entities.name: Lung adenocarcinoma
entities.description: Primary non-small cell lung cancer presenting with chronic cough, hemoptysis, and cavitary or nodular mass.

entities.name: Sarcoidosis
entities.description: Systemic inflammatory disease featuring non-caseating granulomas, symmetric bilateral hilar adenopathy, and uveitis.

entities.name: Silicosis
entities.description: Occupational pneumoconiosis with egg-shell calcified hilar nodes and symmetric upper lobe fibrous nodules.

entities.name: Nontuberculous mycobacterial disease
entities.description: Pulmonary infection caused by environmental mycobacteria (MAC, M. kansasii) in patients with bronchiectasis.

entities.name: Bacterial brain abscess
entities.description: Rapidly expanding focal intracerebral pyogenic infection with smooth thin ring enhancement and acute fever.

entities.name: Cryptococcal meningitis
entities.description: Opportunistic fungal meningitis in immunocompromised patients diagnosed by CSF India ink and cryptococcal antigen.

entities.name: Crohn disease
entities.description: Chronic transmural inflammatory bowel disease with longitudinal ulcers, non-caseating granulomas, and cobblestoning.

entities.name: Lymphoma
entities.description: Hematologic malignancy of lymphoid tissue presenting with diffuse painless adenopathy, fever, and night sweats.

entities.name: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
entities.description: ANCA-associated necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis involving upper and lower respiratory tracts and kidneys.

entities.name: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
entities.description: Opportunistic fungal pneumonia in HIV patients presenting with diffuse perihilar ground glass infiltrates.

relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Cutaneous involvement resulting from direct breakdown and ulceration of skin overlying caseating tuberculous lymph nodes or skeletal lesions.

relationships.description: [MANIFESTS_AS] Subacute basilar meningitis marked by relentless headache, vomiting, personality changes, basilar exudate, and progressive neurological decline.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, severe undernutrition, protein energy malnutrition, wasting, immune deficiency
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Protein-energy malnutrition and micronutrient deficits blunting T-cell proliferation and macrophage antimicrobial peptide production.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, tobacco smoking, cigarette smoke, mucociliary clearance, double risk
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Impairment of mucociliary clearance and macrophage bactericidal function doubling the risk of active tuberculosis.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, chronic alcohol misuse, alcoholism, immune blunting, social vulnerability
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Systemic immune suppression, micronutrient depletion, and social vulnerability predisposing to primary infection and relapse.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, pediatric host, infancy, young children, immature cellular immunity, miliary risk
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Immature cell-mediated immunity in infants and young children (<5 years) conferring high risk of miliary TB and meningitis.

relationships.keywords: HIGH_RISK_HOST, old age, immunosenescence, elderly reactivation, waning immunity
relationships.description: [HIGH_RISK_HOST] Immunosenescence in elderly populations leading to loss of containment of remotely acquired latent mycobacterial reservoirs.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, indolent incubation, weeks to months, insidious onset, incubation timeline
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Clinical manifestations typically emerge indolently over 2 to 12 weeks following initial primary alveolar infection.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, early progression, two-year window, post-primary disease, active breakdown
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Approximately 5 percent of exposed infected individuals develop active progressive clinical disease within 1 to 2 years.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, latent persistence, lifelong latency, dormant bacilli, latent tuberculosis infection
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Viable bacilli persist in dormant metabolic states within calcified granulomas for decades or a lifetime.

relationships.keywords: INCUBATION_PERIOD, late recrudescence, remote reactivation, decades of latency, immunosenescence trigger
relationships.description: [INCUBATION_PERIOD] Remote reactivation can occur decades after exposure following late deterioration of host cell-mediated immune surveillance.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, septic shock, hyperacute collapse, rapid progression, pyogenic sepsis exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Hyperacute onset of toxic fever and respiratory distress evolving within <48–72 hours strongly excludes uncomplicated tuberculosis, which inherently follows an insidious multi-week course.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, hyperacute respiratory failure, rapid ARDS, acute dyspnea, pyogenic pneumonia
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Hyperacute onset of severe fever and respiratory distress developing in under 48 to 72 hours strongly points toward acute pyogenic bacterial community-acquired pneumonia rather than indolent tuberculosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, leukocytosis threshold, toxic bandemia, WBC over 25000, bacterial sepsis exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Profound neutrophilic leukocytosis (>15,000–30,000/µL) with toxic bandemia >15% is distinctly atypical for uncomplicated tuberculosis and points toward acute pyogenic sepsis or melioidosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, peripheral eosinophilia, eosinophils over 15 percent, Paragonimus exclusion, allergic lung disease
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] High-grade peripheral blood eosinophilia (>1,500/µL or >15–30%) strongly rules out pulmonary tuberculosis, pointing instead to parasitic fluke infestations or allergic bronchopulmonary disorders.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, beta-lactam clearance, rapid radiological resolution, penicillin response, bacterial clearing
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Rapid clinical resolution and complete radiological clearance of pulmonary infiltrates within 5–7 days of standard beta-lactam therapy rules out mycobacterial infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, high procalcitonin, bacterial sepsis biomarker, acute pyogenic infection, TB exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Marked hyperacute serum procalcitonin elevation (>5-10 ng/mL) is characteristic of acute pyogenic bacterial bacteremia rather than indolent TB.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, hyperacute discitis, rapid disc collapse, Staphylococcus spondylodiscitis, acute spine destruction
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Destructive breakdown of intervertebral discs and endplates evolving within 48 to 72 hours indicates pyogenic Staphylococcus aureus spondylodiscitis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, acute warm lymphadenitis, pyogenic adenitis, Streptococcus lymphadenitis, cold abscess exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Rapidly developing, exquisitely tender, hot, erythematous cervical adenopathy indicates acute pyogenic bacterial lymphadenitis rather than scrofula.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, neutrophilic pleural fluid, acute empyema, polymorphonuclear predominance, TB pleurisy exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Parapneumonic pleural fluid consisting of >90% polymorphonuclear neutrophils points to acute pyogenic bacterial empyema rather than TB pleurisy.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, transudative pleural effusion, low protein fluid, heart failure transudate, Light criteria transudate
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Low pleural protein (<30 g/L) and low LDH with normal glucose rules out tuberculous pleuritis, indicating congestive heart failure or cirrhosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, migratory arthralgia, acute rheumatic fever, fleeting polyarthritis, monoarthritis exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Acute fleeting polyarthritis shifting rapidly between small joints within hours to days rules out indolent chronic tuberculous monoarthritis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, centrilobular emphysema, thin-walled bullae, absence of infiltrate, active cavity exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Thin-walled, non-infiltrated emphysematous bullae without surrounding consolidation, cavitation, or tree-in-bud nodules excludes active pulmonary TB.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, solitary spiculated nodule, non-cavitary lung mass, lung cancer morphology, afebrile neoplasm
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Solitary non-calcified spiculated lung mass devoid of satellite nodules, cavitation, or inflammatory signs points to primary bronchogenic carcinoma.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, Gram-negative bacteremia, positive blood culture, Burkholderia isolation, bacterial sepsis
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Rapid isolation of Burkholderia, Escherichia, or Pseudomonas from blood cultures within 24 to 48 hours establishes an alternative acute bacterial etiology.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, broad-based budding, Blastomyces yeast, fungal morphology, mycobacteria exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Microscopic demonstration of thick-walled broad-based budding yeast cells excludes tuberculosis, establishing Blastomyces dermatitidis infection.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, pilot-wheel budding, mariner wheel yeast, Paracoccidioides, fungal dimorphism
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Direct microscopic visualization of multiple circumferential buds on parent yeast cells (mariner wheel) diagnostic of Paracoccidioides rules out TB.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, non-caseating granulomas, naked granulomas, sarcoidosis histology, absence of caseation
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Biopsy findings of tightly packed, naked, non-necrotizing non-caseating epithelioid granulomas without central necrosis indicate sarcoidosis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, CSF neutrophilia, acute purulent meningitis, pneumococcal meningitis, TB meningitis exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Cerebrospinal fluid showing thousands of polymorphonuclear leukocytes (>80% neutrophils) with bacteria on Gram stain rules out TB meningitis.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, negative GeneXpert, negative MGIT culture, sterile mycobacterial broth, bacteriological exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Repeatedly negative high-quality sputum molecular GeneXpert tests and sterile 8-week mycobacterial cultures reliably exclude active pulmonary TB.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, negative IGRA and TST, immunocompetent host, negative tuberculin, TB exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Normal T-cell reactivity with repeated strictly negative skin and IGRA tests in immunocompetent hosts makes remote or active infection highly improbable.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, eosinophilic pleural effusion, pleural eosinophils over 10 percent, pneumothorax, TB pleurisy exclusion
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Pleural effusion showing >10% eosinophils virtually excludes tuberculous pleurisy, which is characteristically an intense lymphocytic process.

relationships.keywords: RULED_OUT_BY, macrolide defervescence, azithromycin response, intrinsic macrolide resistance, atypical pneumonia clearing
relationships.description: [RULED_OUT_BY] Total clinical recovery within 72 hours of azithromycin or clarithromycin monotherapy rules out Mycobacterium tuberculosis, which is intrinsically resistant.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Melioidosis, Burkholderia pseudomallei, acute sepsis, splenic honeycomb abscesses
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Melioidosis presents with acute toxic prostration (<1-2 weeks), marked leukocytosis (>15,000/mcL), and visceral honeycomb abscesses; TB presents with multi-week insidious symptoms, normal leukocyte counts, positive acid-fast bacilli, and RIPE response.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Paragonimiasis, lung fluke, raw crustacean ingestion, peripheral eosinophilia
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Paragonimiasis features ingestion of raw freshwater crabs, chocolate-colored rusty sputum, and marked peripheral blood eosinophilia (>15-30%); TB lacks striking eosinophilia and yields positive AFB smear or GeneXpert.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Paracoccidioidomycosis, mulberry stomatitis, South American mycosis, pilot wheel yeast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Paracoccidioidomycosis features mulberry-like stomatitis in the oropharynx, extensive cervical lymphadenopathy, and marine-wheel budding yeasts; TB lacks oral mucosal ulceration and displays acid-fast bacilli.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Histoplasmosis, Histoplasma capsulatum, bat guano, intracellular yeast
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Histoplasmosis is linked to bat or bird guano cave exposure and features tiny intracellular 2 to 4 micron yeast within macrophages and positive urine antigen; TB yields rod-shaped acid-fast bacilli.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Blastomycosis, Blastomyces dermatitidis, verrucous lesions, broad-based budding
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Blastomycosis causes verrucous crusted skin lesions and broad-based budding yeast cells on KOH examination; TB presents with caseating granulomas, apple-jelly lupus vulgaris, and acid-fast bacilli.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Coccidioidomycosis, Valley fever, desert soil exposure, thick-walled spherules
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Coccidioidomycosis occurs after arid desert soil exposure in the Americas and features thick-walled spherules filled with endospores; TB features necrotizing caseation with rod-shaped mycobacteria.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Pyogenic spondylodiscitis, Staphylococcus aureus discitis, acute spinal infection, rapid endplate loss
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Pyogenic spondylodiscitis develops acutely over days with high fever, bacteremia, marked neutrophilia, and rapid disc destruction; TB spondylitis (Pott disease) exhibits indolent months-long progression, cold abscesses, and gibbus.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Pyogenic psoas abscess, Staphylococcal psoas collection, acute groin pain, toxic fever
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Pyogenic psoas abscess (Staphylococcus aureus) presents acutely with toxic fever, warm tender groin mass, and positive blood cultures; TB psoas cold abscess is painless, afebrile, and yields citrine yellow fluid.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Lung adenocarcinoma, bronchogenic carcinoma, malignant cavitary mass, cytology positive
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Lung adenocarcinoma presents in older smokers with irregular eccentric cavitary walls devoid of tree-in-bud satellites, negative AFB, and malignant cytology; TB presents with centrilobular tree-in-bud lesions and positive NAAT.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Sarcoidosis, bilateral hilar adenopathy, non-caseating granulomas, steroid response
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Sarcoidosis demonstrates bilateral symmetrical non-tender hilar adenopathy, non-caseating naked granulomas, and steroid responsiveness; TB displays asymmetric caseating necrotizing granulomas and acid-fast bacilli.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Silicosis, occupational pneumoconiosis, eggshell calcification, silica exposure
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Silicosis features symmetric upper lobe egg-shell hilar calcifications and hyalinized whorled collagenous nodules; TB silicotuberculosis features rapid asymmetrical cavitary necrosis and positive mycobacterial testing.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Nontuberculous mycobacterial disease, Mycobacterium avium complex, Lady Windermere syndrome, negative GeneXpert
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Nontuberculous mycobacteria (MAC) target elderly non-smokers with middle lobe bronchiectasis or underlying COPD, testing negative on GeneXpert MTB/RIF; TB targets upper lobes and is GeneXpert positive.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Bacterial brain abscess, pyogenic cerebration, thin ring enhancement, rapid intracranial mass
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Pyogenic brain abscess develops rapidly over days with acute fever, marked peripheral leukocytosis, and thin smooth ring enhancement; intracranial tuberculomas show thick irregular nodular rim enhancement and chronic course.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Cryptococcal meningitis, Cryptococcus neoformans, India ink positive, cryptococcal antigen
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Cryptococcal meningitis exhibits positive India ink capsule staining and cryptococcal capsular antigen titers in CSF; TB meningitis displays heavy basilar exudate, cranial neuropathies, and positive AFB/NAAT.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Crohn disease, inflammatory bowel disease, longitudinal ulceration, non-caseating granuloma
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Crohn disease presents with longitudinal skip mucosal fissures, cobblestoning, non-caseating granulomas, and perianal fistulae; ileocecal TB shows transverse circular ulcerations, caseating necrosis, and positive PCR.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Lymphoma, Hodgkin disease, non-Hodgkin lymphoma, malignant adenopathy
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphomas cause symmetrical rubbery lymphadenopathy without central liquefactive cold abscess necrosis, revealing monoclonal malignant lymphocytes on flow cytometry; TB shows necrotizing granulomas.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Granulomatosis with polyangiitis, Wegener granulomatosis, PR3-ANCA, saddle nose deformity
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Granulomatosis with polyangiitis features necrotizing granulomatous vasculitis with PR3-ANCA positivity, destructive saddle-nose deformity, and glomerulonephritis; TB is ANCA negative and acid-fast positive.

relationships.keywords: DIFFERENTIATED_FROM, Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, PCP, ground glass opacities, silver stain cysts
relationships.description: [DIFFERENTIATED_FROM] Pneumocystis pneumonia in HIV causes severe hypoxemia with bilateral perihilar ground-glass opacities sparing lung apices and positive silver-stain cysts; TB causes apical cavitations and pleural effusions.
